# Scientific American

> > Scientific American (SciAm) is a leading science publication offering subscription plans for digital and print access to cutting-edge research and science journalism.

Published by Springer Nature America, Inc., Scientific American provides comprehensive coverage of scientific discoveries and research across multiple platforms including web, iOS, and Android applications.
